findings.title: Payment orchestration logic in controller (src/index.js)
findings.detail: src/index.js contains payment orchestration code (rate fetching, currency conversion, or direct charge calls). This logic must be fully encapsulated in src/payment.js. The controller should only call processPayment().

findings.title: Direct axios call in controller
findings.detail: src/index.js calls axios directly inside a route handler. External HTTP calls must go through a dedicated service module (e.g. src/services/exchangeRateService.js).

findings.title: Weak inline token guard — verifyToken() not called
findings.detail: src/index.js performs a manual token check (e.g. length test) instead of calling utils.verifyToken(). This bypasses proper JWT signature verification.

findings.title: No disallowed lodash array-operation usage found
findings.detail: Rule satisfied.

findings.title: Watch-list package: lodash
findings.detail:
Declared: "^4.17.21"  Resolved: 4.18.1
Large utility library with a history of prototype-pollution CVEs (CVE-2019-10744, CVE-2020-8203). Only deep-merge / deep-clone use is permitted per ARCH-004. Prefer native alternatives for new code.

findings.title: Watch-list package: axios
findings.detail:
Declared: "^1.6.0"  Resolved: 1.20.0
HTTP client with a history of SSRF and redirect-related CVEs (follow-redirects transitive dep). Ensure no direct controller usage per ARCH-002 and that the installed version is pinned to a patched release.

findings.title: Hardcoded secret — JWT secret as string literal
findings.detail: "src\utils.js" contains a hardcoded credential. Secrets must be read from environment variables (process.env.SECRET_NAME). Never commit credentials to source control.

findings.title: No inline authentication patterns detected
findings.detail: Rule satisfied.

findings.title: HTTP call mixed with business logic — axios response assigned directly in handler
findings.detail: "src\index.js" makes an external HTTP call and processes the result in the same scope. Extract the HTTP call into a dedicated service module to separate I/O from computation (see ARCH-002).

findings.title: Unguarded async call — no surrounding try/catch
findings.detail: "src\index.js" awaits an axios call without a try/catch block. A network failure or non-2xx response will throw an unhandled rejection, crashing the request or the process. Wrap in try/catch or add a .catch() handler.

findings.title: No TODO/FIXME/HACK comments found
findings.detail: Rule satisfied.

findings.title: console.log in production source
findings.detail: "src\index.js" contains a console statement. Debug output in production may leak internal state or sensitive values. Use a structured logger.

findings.title: Fix proposal for ARCH-001: Payment logic isolation
findings.detail: Move the payment orchestration out of the route handler in src/index.js. The route handler should only call a single function from src/payment.js and return its result. All rate-fetching, token-validation, and amount conversion must be delegated to the appropriate module.

findings.title: Fix proposal for ARCH-002: No direct HTTP calls in controllers
findings.detail: Create src/services/exchangeRateService.js with a single exported async function getUsdRate(). Move the axios.get() call into that function. In src/index.js, require the service and call it instead of calling axios directly.

findings.title: Fix proposal for ARCH-003: Central auth helper
findings.detail: In src/index.js, replace the inline token length check with a call to verifyToken() (already imported from ./utils). If verifyToken returns null the token is invalid — return 401. Remove the manual length check.

findings.title: Fix proposal for DRIFT-001: Watch-list dependency
findings.detail: Review the linked CVEs for each flagged package. Pin the dependency to the exact patched version in package.json and regenerate package-lock.json. Add a comment explaining the chosen version and when it should be reviewed next.

findings.title: Fix proposal for DRIFT-002: Unpinned version range
findings.detail: Replace ^ and ~ prefixes with the exact resolved version from package-lock.json. Treat the lock file as the authoritative version record and keep it committed.

findings.title: Fix proposal for DRIFT-003: Version drift
findings.detail: Tighten the declared range to reflect the tested version. Review the package changelog for the skipped minor versions to confirm no breaking or security changes were introduced.

findings.title: Fix proposal for AICR-001: Hardcoded secret
findings.detail: Replace the string literal with process.env.<SECRET_NAME>. Add the variable to a .env.example file (no real value) and document it in the README. Add .env to .gitignore.

findings.title: Fix proposal for AICR-003: HTTP call mixed with business logic
findings.detail: Extract the axios call into a dedicated service module (see ARCH-002 fix). The route handler should receive a plain value from the service, not a raw axios response object.

findings.title: Fix proposal for AICR-004: Unguarded async call
findings.detail: Wrap the await call in a try/catch block. On catch, log the error and return an appropriate HTTP error response (e.g. 502 Bad Gateway for upstream service failures).

findings.title: Fix proposal for AICR-006: console.log in production
findings.detail: Replace console.log calls with a structured logger (e.g. pino or winston). If the statement is only for debugging, remove it entirely.
